newsitem.title: ESTONIA: MERKO H1 PROFIT 8.5 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: MERKO H1 PROFIT 8.5 MLN KROONS.

text.p: Estonia's construction company Merko said on Wednesday its half-year net profit was 8.5 million kroons, which is half of its 1997 profit estimate.
Merko's net turnover was 169.4 million kroons in the same period, which is also half of its total estimate for the year, it added in a statement.
Its assets have grown by 2.3 times during the first six months of 1997 to 148.9 million kroons. Equity rose by 75.8 million kroons to 102.35 million kroons.
Merko Construction, listed on the main list of the Tallinn bourse, will announce its consolidated figures on August 15 at the latest.
